column1: # Game profile of Super Mario Party (Switch, update 1.1.0). Plays on the Mac
# NintendoWare Bezel Engine 1.21.1, SDK 9.4.0: nearly all of RomFS is in Bezel Engine archives (.bea, zstd entries);
# the shaders are BNSH in their .bfsha / .bnsh entries (the engine's own in System.nxonnx32.bea). The boards, modes and minigames are 20 NROs (nro/NX_Master, one NRR)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = GLSLC, imported and never called; subsdk1 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false and nninitStartup sets a heap of pool − used memory: a 3.14 GB heap in the 4 GB layout
# the NVN depth mode the game sets (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode near = 0): the prebuilt pipeline bases take the main0_z vertex entries
